transform.description: Inverse of Slovene National Grid + Slovenia1996 to WGS84(1), with axis order normalized
transform.definition: proj=pipeline step inv proj=tmerc lat_0=0 lon_0=15 k=0.9999 x_0=500000 y_0=-5000000 ellps=GRS80 step proj=unitconvert xy_in=rad xy_out=deg
transform.caution: Operation accuracy is not source positional accuracy. Diagnostic transformation only; a future accepted WGS84 derivation still needs its separately reviewed CRS evidence and provenance.
